finding: WP510 self-hosted target-runtime evidence has an out-of-band runner-listener readiness dependency. The current self-hosted workflow can prove exact F2 source and target execution only after assignment; it cannot prove its own pre-assignment listener liveness. For a persistent Linux runner, GitHub's documented systemd runner service is the thinnest candidate readiness mechanism. Runner service state, GitHub-side eligibility, assignment, step execution and target-runtime receipt remain separate credits.
security_boundary: Repository runner-roster REST reads require repository Administration(read). Do not introduce a higher-privilege PAT/App credential solely to make runner readiness observable without a later explicit security/owner decision.
